name: Soft mask-aware token merging in frozen SAM2 memory attention
status: prospective; first engineering-gate attempt failed before any ToMe treatment outputs; memory-writer capture correction recorded before retry; do not launch the cohort before the retry gate passes

amendment_history.timing: After the first seq2/seq3 engineering-gate attempt failed and before retry; native replay completed, but no ToMe treatment output was produced.
amendment_history.change: Capture the current frame's pred_masks_high_res tensor at the input to SAM2 _encode_new_memory, instead of trying to read it from the compacted stored output dictionary; pool its sigmoid probabilities onto the matching memory-feature grid.
amendment_history.reason: SAM2VideoPredictor._run_single_frame_inference compacts stored frame outputs and omits pred_masks_high_res. The first gate attempt therefore failed when the observer looked for a field that is not retained. The writer call receives the exact high-resolution prediction tensor that SAM2 uses to construct that frame's memory; this amendment corrects the data source, not the method settings or efficacy criterion.

amendment_history.timing: Before the soft-method seq2/seq3 gate and with no soft-method outputs inspected. The separate Run155 hard-region ToMe cohort was partially observed; this soft candidate is therefore exploratory in the broader study.
amendment_history.change: Record the relevant token-merging literature and why this implementation adapts ToMe rather than copying an encoder-specific segmentation method. No code, merge weight, window, budget, or evaluation criterion changed.
amendment_history.reason: ALGM supports local similarity-based token merging as a segmentation efficiency technique, while StructSAM and the MaskMerge preprint motivate preserving structural or mask distinctions during merging. Their tasks and insertion points differ from frozen SAM2 temporal memory attention; ALGM's public implementation also uses an adaptive threshold, which conflicts with the frozen no-threshold protocol.

amendment_history.timing: Before the soft-method seq2/seq3 gate; no soft-method outputs were inspected.
amendment_history.change: Document the positional approximation caused by applying ToMe after native K/V projection and rotary position encoding.
amendment_history.reason: The merged key is a weighted average of locally positioned, RoPE-transformed keys. Restricting matches to 4x4 windows bounds spatial separation but does not preserve a single exact positional phase. The fixed experiment tests this approximation as implemented; no merge setting or criterion changes.

motivation: Replace hard foreground/interior, boundary, and background merge groups with a continuous occupancy compatibility prior. The method tests whether mask structure helps decide which nearby, similar memory tokens can be averaged without dropping all tokens from a region.

prior_work.token_matching: Token Merging: Your ViT but Faster, ICLR 2023
prior_work.related_idea: MaskMerge and SaMer motivate using predicted object structure to reduce cross-structure token fusion. Their reported tasks differ from frozen temporal SAM2 memory attention; this protocol tests that transfer rather than assuming it works.

adjacent_mask_structure_work.name: ALGM
adjacent_mask_structure_work.scope: Local-then-global token merging in a Segmenter image encoder. Reports efficiency gains and some mIoU gains, but is not a SAM2 temporal-memory method; its released implementation uses an adaptive similarity threshold and encoder-specific patches.

adjacent_mask_structure_work.name: StructSAM
adjacent_mask_structure_work.scope: Preprint on structure-preserving token merging in SAM image encoders using feature-gradient/flatness screening and merge-unmerge. The paper does not supply a SAM2 memory-attention implementation; its screening is not used here.

adjacent_mask_structure_work.name: MaskMerge
adjacent_mask_structure_work.scope: Recent preprint on coarse-mask-constrained merging for image instance segmentation. No official implementation was located during this review; not evidence of video-memory Dice gains.

adjacent_mask_structure_work.name: SaMer
adjacent_mask_structure_work.scope: Feature-spatial token clustering for vision-language retrieval; not a SAM2 VOS memory method.

scope.interpretation: Exploratory only. PolypGen and these sequences have informed earlier method development; sequence-level independence does not establish patient-level independence.

method.read_location: Before native scaled-dot-product memory attention, after K/V projection and spatial RoPE. Preserve native current-frame query, memory writes, decoder, frame schedule, pointer keys, and all SAM2 parameters.
method.similarity_metric: For token i, normalize the mean-over-heads post-RoPE key appearance a_i and the two-component occupancy vector r_i=normalize([1-p_i,p_i]). Give each equally weighted unit contribution: m_i=concat(sqrt(0.5)*a_i, sqrt(0.5)*r_i). ToMe's cosine score is therefore 0.5*cos(a_i,a_j)+0.5*cos(r_i,r_j). No argmax region label or mask threshold is used.
method.locality: Apply upstream ToMe matching independently within non-overlapping 4x4 spatial token windows.
method.fixed_budget: Merge exactly 8 of 16 spatial keys in each full 4x4 window. Use this same fixed count for mask-aware and generic controls; no result-dependent budget.
method.control: Generic local ToMe uses the same window and merge count, with the native post-RoPE key appearance metric only.
method.attention_mass: Use the same upstream weighted-mean merge for K and V and add log(cluster_size) to the attention logits. Pointer keys and values retain mass one and remain bit-identical.
arms: generic local ToMe at 50% spatial compression
soft mask-aware local ToMe at 50% spatial compression
method.memory_write_mask: For each selected past memory frame, capture the pred_masks_high_res tensor as it enters SAM2 _encode_new_memory. SAM2VideoPredictor compacts its saved frame output and drops this tensor, so it cannot be read back from output_dict. The observer records the exact source frame, tensor shape, dtype, and SHA-256 at the writer call. It then applies sigmoid to the raw logits and area-averages each footprint onto that frame's maskmem_features HxW grid (64x64 for the frozen 1024-image Hiera-Tiny setup), yielding continuous occupancy p in [0,1] per spatial memory token. This uses raw predicted occupancy before SAM2's separate memory-mask scale/bias. Require exact integer tiling; do not threshold or substitute the 256x256 decoder output.

engineering_gate.run_after: Run 155 is complete. Run the small seq2/seq3 gate now; its timing is not comparable while Run 150 is active. The full-cohort queue must wait for both a passing retry gate and Run 150 to exit, to avoid CPU contention during efficacy evaluation.
checks: Native full-video replay is bit-identical to archived logits, stored predictions, and object scores on both sequences.
The new observer intercepts each of SAM2's four memory-attention layers once per post-prompt target.

For every selected K/V span, the mask tensor is captured at the SAM2 _encode_new_memory input; the recorded source frame, shape, dtype, and SHA-256 are present, and sigmoid-area-pooled occupancy covers the exact matching memory-feature grid.
SAM2 memory-mask binarization is not applied to the mask-prompt/prediction path used by this gate; fail if a point-prompt binarization path would make raw occupancy inconsistent.
Native SAM2 parameters, memory writes, object pointers, and pointer ordering remain unchanged.
Mask-aware and generic arms retain identical spatial-key counts for every memory frame and local window.
Merged spatial mass equals the original spatial-key count and total key mass includes untouched pointers; all values are finite.
The pinned ToMe source revision and source digest are unchanged.

previous_attempt.failure: The initial implementation expected pred_masks_high_res in compacted stored frame output; SAM2 does not retain this field there.
previous_attempt.preservation: Do not overwrite or delete this attempt.

planned_contrasts: soft mask-aware ToMe minus native SAM2
soft mask-aware ToMe minus generic local ToMe
evaluation.statistics: Paired sequence bootstrap 95% intervals and two-sided Wilcoxon tests with Holm correction over the two planned contrasts.
evaluation.meaningful_screen: At least +0.01 equal-sequence Dice over native; positive mean over generic ToMe; at least 14/21 sequence wins over native; positive lower 95% bounds and Holm-adjusted p<0.05 for both contrasts; no increase in pooled false alarms versus native.
evaluation.decision: Only run the full cohort if this method's own seq2/seq3 gate passes. Apply this frozen screen once; record failure as a negative result without changing the metric, weight, window, budget, or mask processing.

full_cohort.start_condition: Only after the retry gate at 158_soft_mask_aware_tome_polypgen_v1/gate writes completion.json with passed=true and Run 150 has exited.

limitations: The continuous mask prior describes predicted spatial occupancy, not the semantic purity of a K/V vector.
MaskMerge and SaMer are adjacent inspiration, not direct evidence for video memory Dice improvement.
ALGM and StructSAM operate in image encoders, while this adaptation operates on already-positioned temporal memory K/V; no cited work validates this exact placement.
The method is a compression test. Published token-merging results support accuracy/compute trade-offs, not a reliable Dice improvement over dense frozen SAM2.
ToMe was designed for transformer token efficiency, not SAM2 temporal memory accuracy.
Mass correction approximates the contribution of merged keys; it is exact only when merged keys and values are identical.
This PolypGen experiment is exploratory and cannot provide independent confirmation.
The post-RoPE merge averages keys carrying different local rotary phases; 4x4 locality bounds but does not remove this positional approximation.
